constraints.name: c2_receipt_roles_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((external_roles IS NULL) OR (((cardinality(external_roles) >= 1) AND (cardinality(external_roles) <= 3)) AND (array_position(external_roles, NULL::app_role) IS NULL) AND (external_roles <@ ARRAY['parceiro_b2b'::app_role, 'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::app_role, 'cliente_produtor'::app_role]))))
